title: 第17章 初露锋芒第18章 冰与风之舞水与冰之争
slug: 满级雷灵根卷哭修仙界
lines: 玄天剑派的演武场上，早已围满了前来观战的内外门弟子。
中央的比武台被一道透明的结界笼罩，五位小天才的师父们端坐在高台上，准备观摩这场备受关注的比试。
“听说这几个小师叔都是单灵根以上的天才？”
“那个最小的才三岁，真的能打吗？”
“我听说林小师叔三天前就已经突破到炼气二层了！”
“什么？三岁炼气二层？这怎么可能！”
在众人的议论声中，凤临渊抱着林枝意轻盈地落在比武台上。
小公主今天穿着一身利落的紫色练功服，头发高高束起，显得格外精神。
“等下不能哭鼻子哦，”凤临渊轻轻捏了捏她的小脸，“打不过就投降，不丢人。”
林枝意用力点头，小脸上写满认真“嗯！意意知道了！”
她被师父放下后，昂着小脑袋环视四周，奶声奶气却气势十足“谁和我来？”
另一边，钱多多也被他的师父抱上台。
小胖子今天特意穿了一身金光闪闪的练功服，胖乎乎的小手举得老高“意意妹妹我抽到的和你打！”
他的师父也蹲下身嘱咐“多多记住，打疼了不能哭鼻子，不行就投降，知道吗？”
“知道啦！”钱多多拍着小胸脯，“多多很勇敢的！”
台下的弟子们看着这两个三岁和五岁的小团子，都觉得这场比试更像是过家家。
“这么小的娃娃，能有什么实力？”
“还撑起结界，太夸张了吧？”
“小孩打闹而已，何必这么认真？”
然而，当比试正式开始的钟声响起时，所有人都收起了轻视之心。
“多多哥哥，让我看看你的实力！”林枝意小手结印，周身泛起紫色电光。
钱多多也收起嬉笑，胖乎乎的小手快速结印“金剑术！”
一柄金色的小剑凭空出现，带着锋锐的气息直射向林枝意。
这一手标准的金系法术，让台下顿时安静下来。
“雷盾术！”林枝意不慌不忙，在身前凝聚出一面紫色的雷电盾牌。
金剑与雷盾相撞，发出刺耳的撞击声。电光与金芒四溅，在结界上激起阵阵涟漪。
“这、这是三岁孩子能使出的法术？”
“那个雷盾的强度，已经堪比炼气中期了！”
“天才不愧是天才”
台下的弟子们目瞪口呆，终于明白为什么要撑起结界了。
若是没有结界保护，他们这些围观者恐怕真的会被波及。
一击未中，钱多多也不气馁，小胖手再次结印“金遁术！”
他的身影瞬间化作一道金光，灵活地躲过了林枝意随后发出的引雷术。
由于今天天气晴朗，没有乌云相助，这道引雷术的威力确实打了折扣。
“《瑞金决》！”钱多多娇喝一声，周身金光大盛，数柄金色小剑在身前成型，带着凌厉的气势向林枝意飞去。
林枝意小脸严肃，不退反进“雷击术！”
她掌心凝聚出一道粗壮的紫色电光，与飞来的金剑正面相撞。
巨大的爆炸声在结界内回荡，金紫两色光芒交织，刺得人睁不开眼。
当光芒散去，两个小团子依然稳稳地站在台上，只是都有些气喘吁吁。
令人惊讶的是，尽管年纪幼小，但两人的施法姿势和战斗意识都相当标准，显然是经过严格训练的。
content_en:
Xuantian Sword Sect's martial arts performance field was already crowded with inner and outer sect disciples who came to watch the battle.
The competition platform in the center was shrouded by a transparent barrier. The masters of the five young geniuses were sitting on the high platform, preparing to observe this much-anticipated competition.
"I heard that these junior uncles are all geniuses with single spiritual roots or above?"
"The youngest is only three years old, can he really fight?"
"I heard that Junior Master Lin broke through to the second level of Qi Refining three days ago!"
"What? Three-year-old Qi Refining Level 2? How is this possible!"
Amid everyone's discussion, Feng Linyuan landed lightly on the competition stage with Lin Zhiyi in his arms.
The little princess was wearing a neat purple training uniform today, with her hair tied high, looking particularly energetic.
"Don't cry later," Feng Linyuan pinched her little face gently, "If you can't beat me, just surrender. There's no shame in it."
Lin Zhiyi nodded vigorously, his face full of seriousness, "Yes! I understand!"
After she was put down by her master, she looked around with her little head raised, and said in a milky voice but full of momentum, "Who is coming with me?"
On the other side, Qian Duoduo was also carried onto the stage by his master.
The little fat man specially wore a glittering training suit today, and raised his chubby little hands high, "Sister Yiyi, I will fight you with whatever I draw!"
His master also knelt down and told him, "Remember, don't cry if it hurts. If you can't, surrender. Do you understand?"
"I know!" Qian Duoduo patted his chest, "Duoduo is very brave!"
The disciples in the audience looked at the two little dumplings aged three and five and felt that this competition was more like playing house.
"What strength can such a small baby have?"
"Isn't it too exaggerated to hold up the barrier?"
"It's just kids playing around, why do you have to be so serious?"
However, when the bell rang for the official start of the competition, everyone put away their contempt.
"Brother Duoduo, let me see your strength!" Lin Zhiyi formed a seal with his small hands, and purple lightning flashed around his body.
Qian Duoduo also stopped laughing and quickly formed the seal of "Golden Sword Technique!" with his chubby little hands.
A small golden sword appeared out of thin air, shooting straight at Lin Zhiyi with a sharp aura.
This standard gold spell made the audience suddenly quiet.
"Thunder Shield Technique!" Lin Zhiyi calmly formed a purple thunder shield in front of him.
The golden sword collided with the thunder shield, making a harsh collision sound. Electric light and golden light splashed out, causing ripples on the barrier.
"This, is this a spell that a three-year-old can use?"
"The strength of that thunder shield is already comparable to the middle stage of Qi refining!"
"A genius is worthy of being a genius"
The disciples in the audience were stunned and finally understood why the barrier was raised.
Without the protection of the barrier, onlookers like them might really be affected.
Qian Duoduo was not discouraged even though he missed a hit, the little chubby hand once again formed the seal "Golden Escape Technique!"
His figure instantly turned into a golden light, and he nimbly dodged Lin Zhiyi's subsequent lightning technique.
Since the weather is sunny today and there are no dark clouds to help, the power of this lightning drawing technique is indeed reduced.
""Ruijin Jue"!" Qian Duoduo shouted softly, golden light bloomed all over his body, several small golden swords took shape in front of him, and flew towards Lin Zhiyi with fierce momentum.
Lin Zhiyi's face was serious, and instead of retreating, he launched the "Lightning Strike Technique!"
A thick purple electric light condensed in her palm and collided head-on with the flying golden sword.
"Boom——!!!"
A huge explosion echoed within the barrier, and the golden and purple lights intertwined, making people unable to open their eyes.
When the light dissipated, the two little dumplings were still standing firmly on the stage, but they were both a little out of breath.
Surprisingly, despite their young age, their spell-casting postures and combat awareness are quite standard, and they have obviously undergone rigorous training.
